summary: Mississippi Forestry Commission lookout on Lee County's highest point; the tower is gone, concrete footings remain, and a radio tower stands on the commission's 0.1-acre parcel.

facts.status_note: Tower gone; concrete footings remain and the Forestry Commission's 0.1-acre parcel hosts a radio tower (FFLOS)

events.note: Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register January 1, 2026, nominated by Doug Sprouse

evidence.quote: This tower was located at the highest point in Lee County.
Concrete footings from the lookout tower remain on site.

evidence.supports: commission owns 0.1 acres; radio tower continues on site
evidence.quote: The Forestry Commission still owns 0.1 acres at the site, which continues to host a radio tower.

notes_for_editor: Only one source (the FFLOS page). Two WebSearch calls and one websearch.py fallback found nothing about this tower, its build, staffing, or removal. The story is shorter than the 120-word floor because the evidence is that thin. Access not classified. Brief kind 'unknown' could be 'tower': the FFLOS description calls it 'This tower'. Build year and removal date are unknown; no year was inferred.
